subject: A shared web canvas with a container-sized preview
text:
Hi Chris,

Your description of CodePen as a place to experiment and prototype made me think this might interest you: I make Take The Wall, one public page whose content is replaced by the next activated takeover.

The free designer lets people arrange a message or project and compare desktop/mobile previews inside a dialog. The preview uses CSS container sizing and cqw typography.

https://www.takethewall.com/?take=1

Would it fit something you would share with web experimenters? This is a project tip, not a sponsorship request. Live placement is separate, with paid checkout or reviewed free email entry.

Take The Wall
contact@takethewall.com
priorReviewReason: Review cited older cold-email pause and personal Gmail contact. No retry or workaround.
